summary.suggested: The Missouri Republican announced that Tom Allen would spar Morris O'Connell at O'Connell's farewell benefit at Tom Kelly's the next Wednesday, Allen's first appearance with the gloves since returning to St. Louis.

metadata.notes: Masthead: 'The Republican: St. Louis, Sunday Morning, February 18, 1883', page 16.

facts.fact: Allen was announced to spar Morris O'Connell in full ring costume at O'Connell's farewell benefit at Tom Kelly's, his first appearance with the gloves since his return to St. Louis

notes: Date is 'next Wednesday' after Sunday Feb 18, so Feb 21; article 687 confirms the bout took place.
